topline.text: A new independent report, "The Cost of Waiting," warns that prolonged delays in SEND provision increase safeguarding and welfare risk for vulnerable children, drawing on FOI responses from 16 local authorities.
topline.action: Useful evidence if you're pressing a local authority on interim provision while a child awaits an EHCP or specialist placement.

topline.text: DfE's fortnightly sector bulletin (DfE Update, 9 September) went out this week — worth a scan for any grant deadlines or data-collection asks relevant to your school.
topline.action: Check the update for anything time-limited that affects your setting.

diary.text: DfE EOTAS (education otherwise than at school) consultation closes.
Rotherham Schools Forum meets — agenda includes the exclusion & suspensions annual report and an EHCP update.

items.lede: "The Cost of Waiting" — new report on SEND delays.
items.body: The report examines what happens when children with SEND can't access suitable education for prolonged periods, arguing schools should weigh the wider educational, emotional and safeguarding implications of reduced timetables or waits for specialist placement, and calls for more consistent recognition of urgency across local authorities.
items.action: A citable source if you're escalating a case where interim provision has stalled.

items.body: The department's regular fortnightly bulletin to schools and trusts was published this week; it typically covers grant deadlines, data-collection windows and operational guidance rather than headline policy.

box.quote: It's a quiet weekend on the national wires — the next few days are a good moment to catch up on the EOTAS consultation before it closes 18 September.
